name: The Rare Bird's Son
source:
"If it wasn't for you…"

A peaceful afternoon at a sun-lit dōjō in 17th-century Japan. Half-demon Kyū has just finished a sword-fighting lesson with his student, but the boy has some questions that need answering.

[From [url=https://takanohiro.itch.io/the-rare-birds-son]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果不是你……”

17世纪日本阳光明媚的道场度过了一个宁静的下午。半妖休刚刚和他的学生上完剑术课，但这个男孩有一些问题需要回答。

[来自[url=https://takanohiro.itch.io/the-rare-birds-son]Itch.io[/url]]
